title: Session cookie cleared with an empty value
summary: A synthetic Set-Cookie response header that clears a session cookie with an empty value and a past expiry date.
rationale: The cookie name states a session role and the header is a Set-Cookie carrier, but the value is empty so there is no nonce to leak; a flag keyed on the name or the header would be a false alarm and would hide the deletion for readers.

expectation.rationale: Not flagged. RFC 6265 allows a cookie-value of zero cookie-octets, and an empty value holds no session identifier; the expiry attribute is a date, not a credential.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. Authored from the cited standards read on 2026-10-03, before any scanner was consulted. All values are synthetic and were not tested against any service. Header coalescing, parser and action policy, decoded-token mapping and product masking stay with the downstream repositories.
